name: T4  One belief: hiring another admin

slides.text: Hiring another admin is the expensive fix
Every new customer brings more messages, invoices and reminders.

data.alt: three stacks of admin work, each taller

slides.text: A new hire types the same details into the same places. Now two people do it.

data.alt: details typed from Gmail into a spreadsheet into QuickBooks, then again

slides.text: Before you hire, list every task where someone copies details from one screen to another.

data.alt: a task list split between a system and people

slides.text: Move those to a system. Keep people for calls and customers who want a person.

data.alt: time spent copying falls after a system goes in, time with customers rises

slides.text: Before you hire for admin, move the copying to a system first.
